pairs.subject: test-harness
pairs.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/circuit_breaker.rs:38 load_active, upsert and purge_expired have no test of their own. Their only caller is ProviderCircuitBreaker::with_persistence (src-tauri/engine/src/failover.rs:202), and every failover test builds the breaker with ::new() (pool: None). That means the positional row.get mapping, the '-N minutes' TTL predicate and the reconstruction of open state after a restart can all break while every suite stays green. Five other files in this context have zero #[test] as well: policy_events, scheduled_retries, test_suites, annotations and credential_recipes.

techniques.evidence: src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/circuit_breaker.rs:48 The TTL restore decision is reached by no test. The failover suite makes the persistence branch unreachable by building every breaker with ::new() (failover.rs:190), and nothing declares or lists that unreached region.

src-tauri/db/src/lib.rs:2466 init_test_db, which every test in this context uses, builds the migrated template once and copies it per test. It probes the copy before handing it over (:2482) and sweeps stale copies once per process (:2406).
src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/executions.rs:2834 The cache test picks a cache key unique to itself, so tests running in parallel cannot serve or evict each other's heatmap snapshot.
src-tauri/db/src/repos/execution/executions.rs:4496 The monthly-rollup window test places rows at computed instants instead of waiting on sleeps.
